name: Locomotive Half Marathon 2026
short_description: A half marathon, with 10 km, 5 km and a 3 km category for invited disabled participants, held in Bandar Lampung, Indonesia on 20 September 2026, starting and finishing at Tugu Adipura.
ai_summary: The Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 was held on Sunday 20 September 2026 in Bandar Lampung, Lampung, Indonesia, starting and finishing at Tugu Adipura in Enggal. Organised by PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI) Divre IV Tanjungkarang with RAW Organizer (Runaway Lampung), it marked the 81st anniversaries of KAI and the TNI and offered a 21.1 km half marathon (5am start, four-hour cut-off), 10 km, 5 km and a 3 km category for invited disabled participants. KAI reported 3,000 runners.

core_facts.organizer: PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI), executed by RAW Organizer / Runaway Lampung

pros: 5am start for the 21 km, ahead of the morning heat
Entry from Rp175,000 (5 km) to Rp350,000 (21 km) in the 2026 first phase
Jersey, chip-timed bib and finisher medal for every entrant
Start and finish at Tugu Adipura in central Bandar Lampung
cons: No route map, aid-station plan or results published for the 2026 race
Run on city roads; KAI warned residents of traffic disruption
Haze cut visibility at the nearby airport on 2026 race morning

excerpt_quotes.quote: Kita mengerahkan 42 personel yang tersebar di pusat lokasi maupun ruas jalan yang nantinya dilintasi para peserta run
excerpt_quotes.attribution: AKP Agustina Nilawati (Bandar Lampung Police PR) on the 2025 Locomotive Run, Tribratanews Polda Lampung

research_highlights: The 2026 edition adds a 21K half-marathon distance alongside 5K and 10K categories, per event listing on schedules.run.
The race is scheduled for Sunday, September 20, 2026 in Bandar Lampung, organized by Raw Organizer / Runaway Lampung.
Previous 'Locomotive Run' editions (April 2025) started and finished at Tanjungkarang railway station, routing past city landmarks ('Icon Kota Bandar Lampung') before returning to the station.
Past editions drew over 2,000 participants including KAI employees, running communities, the general public, and a disability category from Yayasan Harapan Masa Depan Lampung.
Along the route in prior editions, organizers provided music entertainment, water stations, and cheer zones ('zona cheer up') to support runners.
research_watchouts: No first-hand participant race reports or reviews for the half-marathon (21K) distance were found, since prior 'Locomotive Run' editions only offered 5K/10K/3K categories — this appears to be the event's first year including a half-marathon.

Local police mobilized traffic control personnel along the route for the 2025 edition, indicating runners and spectators should expect road closures/traffic management around the Tanjungkarang station area.

faqs.question: When is the Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: It was held on Sunday 20 September 2026 in Bandar Lampung, Lampung. The half marathon flagged off at 5am, the 10 km at 5.30am, the 5 km at 5.45am and the 3 km for invited disabled participants at 6am, with the half-marathon course closing after four hours.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at this race?
faqs.answer: Four categories: a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km and a 5 km, plus a 3 km for invited disabled participants. Cut-offs were four hours for the half, 2 hours 45 minutes for the 10 km and 1 hour 30 minutes for the 5 km, and phase-one entry cost IDR 175,000 to IDR 365,000.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Locomotive Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 is organized by PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI), the national railway company, with event execution handled by RAW Organizer together with Runaway Lampung. This partnership brings together a major national organization and local race organizers to deliver the event in Bandar Lampung.

faqs.question: Where exactly does the race start?
faqs.answer: The race started and finished at Tugu Adipura in Enggal, central Bandar Lampung, according to the pre-race release from Korem 043/Garuda Hitam, and the course used the city's main roads. KAI asked residents to plan journeys around road closures on race morning.
